english.notes:
(i) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(ii) See offence wordings: H1013, H1014, H1015. H4105 and H4113 which relate to similar offences specifically when driving on a footpath beside a road under section 72 of the Highways Act 1835.
(iii) As amended by paragraph 5 of Schedule 7 to the Countryside and Rights of Way Act 2000.
(iv) Fixed penalty scheme may be applied.
(v) DVLA code added under section146 Powers of Criminal Courts (Sentencing) Act 2000 and in accordance with and H.O.C. 59/2003.
